archetype: Hybrid: Archetype 5 (Luxury/Depth) blended with Archetype 1 (Organic/Soft) for a 'Cozy Night Room' feel.

headings.style: Soft, expressive, warm. Tracking-tight for larger sizes.
headings.usage: Used for 'Recovery Mode' welcome text, Session titles, Character speech bubbles to add a human, analog touch.

body.usage: Used for auto-extracted tasks, live transcripts, insights, navigation, and small labels.

layout_and_spacing.strategy: The 'Control Room' Grid but heavily padded for Zen focus. No visual clutter. Elements should feel like they are floating in space.
layout_and_spacing.workspace_grid: 3-column layout. Left: History/Insights (25%). Center: Orb + Voice Bar (50%). Right: Tasks & Notes (25%). Center column is the primary focus area.
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous. p-6, p-8, p-12. Containers must have internal padding.
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: rounded-2xl to rounded-3xl for major panels to feel soft, organic, and forgiving.
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Optical alignment over geometrical. Center the Orb and Voice Bar for an anchored feel.

character_design.name: Mysl Companion
character_design.concept: A soft, glowing, formless orb/blob. NOT a corporate mascot. Minimal facial features (just expressions via motion/glow). Should feel like a gentle presence in the room.
character_design.visual_execution: CSS radial-gradients or framer-motion `div` with heavy blur (backdrop-blur). Mixes primary (blue) and secondary (purple) colors.

animations.idle: Slow scaling (scale 1 to 1.05) over 4-6 seconds to mimic deep breathing.
animations.listening: Outer glow increases, subtle ripple border.
animations.speaking: Quick pulsing synced to voice frequency/text reveal.
animations.thinking: Gradient rotation or slight horizontal squash (blinking).

voice_capture_bar.design: Pill-shaped floating bar. Uses Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl, bg-white/5, 1px border). Contains a dynamic audio waveform.

live_transcript.design: Vertical fade-out mask (mask-image: linear-gradient). Only shows the last 2-3 lines of text to prevent overwhelming the user. Fades text opacity for older words.

task_card.design: Flat, 1px subtle border, no heavy drop shadows. Gentle hover state. Checkmark uses 'success' mint color. No red/urgent text.

recovery_mode.design: Full-screen overlay. Deepest background. Soft, centered Fraunces heading. Forgiving tone. 'Warm Peach' accent button to resume.

notion_sync.design: Top right elegant pill. Shows 'Synced to Notion' with a tiny pulsing dot. Never red/error, only 'Syncing...' or 'Synced'.

auth_pages.design: Minimalist center card. Glassmorphic panel over the dark abstract noise background. Uses Shadcn Form, Input, Button heavily customized to match the dark aesthetic.

background_texture.usage: Use with opacity 0.03 to 0.06 and mix-blend-overlay or soft-light as a full-screen background noise for tactile warmth.

accessibility_and_testing.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Character breathing should be subtle. Remove all flashing or strobing effects.
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure soft white-blue foreground text passes APCA contrast against the dark background.
accessibility_and_testing.test_ids: MANDATORY: data-testid must be on all interactive elements using kebab-case role-based naming (e.g., start-session-button).

instructions_to_main_agent: Use framer-motion for character animations. Ensure the orb uses the blue/purple gradient from the problem statement.
Override default shadcn styles to remove harsh borders and bright white backgrounds. Everything must align with the dark 'cozy' theme.
Do NOT use red for overdue or missed tasks. Use soft greys or the 'warning' peach color to remove guilt.
Install framer-motion for the companion breathing/pulsing.
CRITICAL: All generated files must be .js, not .tsx.
